QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts 3] The Final Countdown
QuestInfo.0: Ask #bKrania#k how to activate the self-destruct system.
QuestInfo.1: In order to activate the #rself-destruct system#k and take out both the Aspire facility and Scion with it, you need to find and activate the secret switches located on each floor of Aspire's basement levels. Once you've flipped every switch, find\r\n#bSpencer#k in the Central Control Room.
QuestInfo.2: You've done everything necessary to activate the #rself-destruct system#k, but now there's a message telling you that the delayed activation settings are offline. How will you get around THIS obstacle?

default.0: Are you still looking for the secret switches to activate the #rself-destruct system#k? You should be able to find them on each floor of the basement levels. While you're doing that, I'll head to the Central Control Room!
